report:
Initial stage: SS hydration is independently repeated by two credited retailer accounts, A04 and A08, under different conditions: pre-makeup use and use with tretinoin/other actives. This supports reported hydration, not measured efficacy or a particular formula. No direct hydration opposition appears in the available testimony. A09 separately reports hydration retention with Avant Guard plus SS; it cannot allocate the outcome between mask and serum.

Texture evidence is mixed in description, without a demonstrated incompatibility: A03 finds SS stickier than Wave Serum but continues using SS because of its believed higher glycerin content; A04 describes SS as lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying and hydrating without a clogged-pore feeling. These different attributes and conditions do not corroborate a precise shared texture proposition or establish a universally nonsticky product. A03's independence is unavailable. No focal non-user texture speculation is present; A03's uncertainty concerns glycerin content, not whether they used SS.

Other-product results remain separate: A04 reports Buffer Jelly overnight glow/clean-looking skin and face-wash hydration, makeup removal and cessation of breakouts; A10 reports Buffer Jelly retaining hydration from unspecified products overnight. A04 and A10 repeat overnight glow associated with Buffer Jelly, but this does not corroborate SS hydration. A09's small-head/nose fit complaint accompanies a positive retention report and a one-star deduction.

Explicit behavior: A04 narrates ordering SS after introduction by a sister, then buying Buffer Jelly for greater nighttime hydration/repair, the face wash, and the mesh moisturizer. These are reported acquisitions, not proof that SS hydration alone caused all purchases. Refill metadata does not establish a narrated repurchase. A03 reports continued SS use despite relative stickiness, not repurchase. No focal return, abandonment or completed remedy is narrated.

Engagement: A03 has Reddit score 6, supplied as material_positive=false and not interpreted; each of A04/A07/A08/A09/A10 has 0 up-votes and 0 down-votes. Observation times are unavailable. No material resonance posture is established. Scores do not establish experiences, independence, prevalence or buying effects.

Material context, outside focal counts: parent commenter hillary_____k (Reddit t1_m7j6ppe, 2025-01-16) reports buying Regimen Lab Level Serum during Black Friday, brighter/even skin, and strong future repurchase intention; score 24, observation time unavailable. This is another product and cannot support SS performance or completed repurchase. The thread opener asks about Regimen Lab after advertising exposure; actor, time and engagement are unavailable in the supplied post context. Product-page and review metadata resolve product/variant and self-reported skin type, but donate no testimony. Formula versions remain unknown.

Retrieval stage: the exact A07 record still contains only “undefined...”; testimony remains unavailable. Its repeated record and contexts are the same source, adding no account, origin or experience. Counts therefore reflect available assertions, not assumed negative experiences. No separate second-stage focal evidence was supplied, so no second-stage change can be diagnosed.

source_index.findings: Iusedtobealawyer; Reddit comment m7jkz2b, 2025-01-17. First-hand SS texture comparison: Wave Serum is less sticky; continues SS because it supposedly has more glycerin ('I think'). No direct hydration outcome or purchase/repurchase claim. SS SKU/formula unknown; independence unavailable. Score 6, material_positive=false, observation time unavailable. Parent's Level Serum praise/purchase intention is separate testimony about another product.

Junip 7540631; credited customer 202931541, 2025-03-22. SS directly reported lightweight, refreshing, fast-drying and very hydrating without clogged-pore feeling, suitable pre-makeup. Ordered SS after sister's introduction; wanted more nighttime hydration/repair and bought Buffer Jelly, reporting overnight glowing/clean skin with a tiny amount despite initial thick/oily concern. Bought face wash, reporting no more breakouts, makeup removal and hydration; immediately bought new mesh moisturizer; praises colorful packaging. These other-product benefits are not SS outcomes. Metadata: Combo + Sensitive, SS Refill, verified buyer; no narrated refill repurchase or known formula. Votes 0 up/0 down; observation time unavailable.

Junip 6884815; credited customer 122992865, 2025-01-17. Original and retrieved exact text both 'undefined...': hydration, texture and behavior testimony unavailable. Metadata identifies SS First Time, Combo skin and verified buyer, but cannot establish use, acquisition narrative or benefit. Same retrieved source adds no observation or origin. Formula unknown; votes 0 up/0 down, observation time unavailable; excluded from all four assertion counts.

Junip 4653282; credited customer 152576810, 2024-02-02. Age 51 with challenging skin; directly reports SS leaving skin hydrated when paired with tretinoin and other actives. Supports conditional reported hydration, not isolated efficacy or texture. Metadata: SS First Time, Combo + Acne Prone, verified buyer; formula unknown. No explicit acquisition, repurchase or remedy consequence. Votes 0 up/0 down; observation time unavailable.

Junip 1866323; credited customer 55537943, 2022-12-09. Avant Guard plus SS reportedly locks in serum hydration; counted as joint retention, not separately allocated SS hydration or texture. Deducted one star for poor fit on very small head, especially nose, alongside praise. Metadata resolves Avant Guard Small Head and Dry + Acne Prone skin; formula/version otherwise unknown. No return, repurchase or remedy narrated. Votes 0 up/0 down; observation time unavailable.

Junip 3515905; credited customer 97396127, 2023-07-21. Context resolves Buffer Jelly: small amount used as final nighttime step locks in unspecified hydrating products, with glowing skin on waking. SS is not identified; provides no SS hydration/texture corroboration. Metadata: Combo skin, verified buyer; formula unknown. No explicit buying, repurchase or remedy consequence. Votes 0 up/0 down; observation time unavailable.
